visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with an extreme close-up of a holographic Mew card inside a circular light frame on an arcade machine. The camera tilts slightly, revealing a brightly lit indoor arcade setting with yellow industrial-style metal grating. (2) Transition to a medium shot of the Pokémon Mezastar arcade cabinet, which is red and black. The screen shows gameplay with a Metagross, while various physical buttons and card slots are visible on the console. (3) A hand is seen inserting coins into a metallic slot labeled with Takara Tomy A.R.T.S and Marvelous logos. The lighting is sharp and professional, highlighting the texture of the machine. (4) The screen displays a Charizard animation as a hand holds up a newly captured 'Six-Star Super Charizard X' card. The background shows other game machines and blurred figures of passers-by in the distance. (5) Two men are shown sitting at the arcade cabinets; one wears a grey hat and glasses while the other is in a denim jacket. They are actively pressing buttons in a synchronized manner, surrounded by bright neon arcade lights. (6) A large table is covered with piles of physical Pokémon cards, a tripod, and a smartphone. The scene shifts to a phone screen scanning a QR code for the SEGA Taiwan LINE account on a red surface.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Subtitle]: 今天來到地下街來玩. (2) [Slogan]: Pokémon Mezastar. [Logo]: Marvelous. (3) [Subtitle]: 來開局直接先來一抽. [Slogan]: 30元準備投入. (4) [Subtitle]: 六星超級噴火龍X. (5) [Subtitle]: 就先拿你來戰鬥吧. [Variety]: 可惡打輸了. (6) [Subtitle]: 有個好貼心的設計. [Slogan]: 直接抽卡 or 對戰捕捉 都沒問題! (7) [Subtitle]: 果然是寶可夢大師之一. (8) [Slogan]: 加入SEGA Taiwan卡片遊戲 LINE 官方帳號. (9) [Subtitle]: 所有的寶可夢訓練家們 等你來玩了.

visual_human_presence.countingEvidence: 1 main creator filming, 1 friend playing, and 2 other players in the background.
visual_human_presence.mainCharacterDescription: The main narrator is mostly behind the camera showing his hands, while his friend wears a grey fedora-style hat, glasses, and a beige shirt.

visual_scene_and_style.backgroundDescribe: An indoor arcade mall with rows of gaming cabinets, yellow metal mesh partitions, and tables used for sorting gaming cards.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) High-energy male narration begins immediately over an upbeat, major-key electronic synth track. The voice exhibits a fast tempo and dramatic pitch variations to convey excitement about the arcade visit. (2) A sharp metallic click is heard as a coin is inserted, followed by the mechanical sound of the machine's dispense motor and a short, bright 'ding' sound effect. (3) The narrator's voice arousal peaks during the reveal of a rare card, accompanied by percussive hit SFX in the BGM. Background room tone of a busy arcade is subtly present but well-controlled. (4) The audio transitions between different clips with hard cuts, maintaining a dense sequence of enthusiastic speech and game-themed musical transitions. (5) Narrator explains game features with clear articulation, while a synthesized cartoon 'pop' sound effect occurs during a text reveal. The music maintains a consistent high-tempo BPM throughout. (6) Final closing remarks are delivered with a humorous rising intonation, ending with a signature comical sound effect as the video cuts off.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To promote the Pokémon Mezastar arcade game by showcasing the thrill of catching rare cards and highlighting user-friendly features like app integration.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: Displays clear brand branding for Pokémon and SEGA, encourages users to join the official LINE account, and highlights the specific game location.
